title: 14 Changes I Made to My Home: air, water, light and noise fixes for a healthier house
summary: Bryan Johnson lists 14 steps he took after testing his home and finding toxins everywhere: remove shoes, monitor and filter air, clean water, avoid plastics, non-stick pans and gas stoves, and control light and noise for sleep. Many fixes are quick or free, and he stresses patience since it took him 5 years.

principles.text: Take your shoes off at the door to keep outdoor contaminants out of your body.
principles.quote: Once these contaminants are inside your house, they're far more likely to get inside your body.

principles.text: Measure indoor air quality and make the HVAC filter your first line of defense, using the highest MERV your system supports.
principles.quote: Your HVAC system should be your first line of defense for air quality. Upgrade your filter and clean it regularly.

principles.text: Clean your water with reverse osmosis that includes a remineralization step.
principles.quote: Make sure your reverse osmosis system includes a remineralization step for electrolyte balance.

principles.text: Swap non-stick pans for stainless steel or cast iron to avoid PFAS.
principles.quote: Use stainless steel or cast iron pans instead.

principles.text: Use dim red light in the evening and block light and noise in the bedroom to protect sleep.
principles.quote: Use a dim red light ~2 hours before bed to help your body wind down and prepare for sleep.

principles.text: Don't be anxious about toxins; remove the big ones gradually.
principles.quote: Be patient with yourself. It took me 5 years to improve my home environment.
